content:
sasha: Quick ask — who can greenlight the KV prefetch serialization change in my PR? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/48732. This toggles `kv_prefetch_mode=serial` behind a feature flag and alters snapshot ordering. Need approvals from runtime + infra + sec before I merge into staging.
ryan: I can take runtime. Quick skim shows the change limits concurrent prefetches to 1 per shard, right? Concern about latency tail.
maya: Platform scope: agree we need infra + sec signoff. Can you add a short perf run showing p95 with the flag on/off? That will speed approvals.
sasha: Yes — perf run attached in PR comments (local cluster). p50: +2ms, p95: +18ms on our synthetic mix. Also note it reduces memory pressure under high-concurrency.
aj: Infra: I'll check memory/eviction interactions. If it indeed reduces memory spikes, infra is more comfortable. Can you add a config toggle in the orchestration template so ops can flip it without a deploy?
sasha: Already added a k8s configmap flag and documented the toggle in the PR description.
tess: Security: need a quick note on feature-flag scope and whether any sensitive path could leak ordering info. From code read, looks fine but please add a unit test for the serialization boundary conditions.
sasha: Will add the unit test and a short security note in PR.
ryan: FYI, runtime caveat: when sequence length > 8k the serialized prefetch could stall next-token work if not pipelined. I added a TODO to the PR to revisit pipelining, but OK to proceed if infra is happy.
aj: I'll run a small canary on staging tomorrow morning (09:30 PT) and validate evictions + pod restarts. If green, infra LGTMed.
maya: Once infra is green and security test is added, I can do the final platform approval and schedule merge in midday slot (noon PT) to avoid peak traffic.
sasha: Thanks all — tracking: add unit test (done by EoD), infra canary tomorrow, platform merge noon. @ryan @aj @tess please reply here when you sign off so I can merge. :thumbsup:
ryan: signing off (runtime) — saw the perf notes and added inline comment about the pipeline TODO.
aj: infra LGTMed after canary passed (ran canary, small spike but recovery ok).
tess: security LGTMed after test added.
maya: platform LGTMed, merging at 12:05 PT. Good job. :party_parrot:
